bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
image=create-videobot:video-topic-cleanup-shared-13356757
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 31
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:video-dualmode-button-download-dc4578de --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 32
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$image" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 33
test -d /mnt/g/Gserver/CreateVdobot/media-work && mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 39
getenv(){ docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n "s/^$1=//p" | head -n 1; }
dbhost="$(getenv VIDEOBOT_DB_HOST)"
dbuser="$(getenv VIDEOBOT_DB_USER)"
dbname="$(getenv VIDEOBOT_DB_NAME)"
tokenfile="$(getenv VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_FILE)"
test -n "$dbhost" && test -n "$dbuser" && test "$dbname" = videobot && test "$tokenfile" = /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token || exit 34
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 35
docker run --rm --network "container:$cid" --volumes-from "$cid" -v "/mnt/g/Gserver/CreateVdobot/media-work:/var/lib/videobot/media-work:rw" --entrypoint node \
 -e "VIDEOBOT_DB_HOST=$dbhost" -e "VIDEOBOT_DB_USER=$dbuser" \
 -e "VIDEOBOT_DB_NAME=$dbname" -e "VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_FILE=$tokenfile" \
 "$image" /opt/videobot/src/operations/runDuplicateVideoCleanup.mjs > /home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/video-topic-cleanup-fe666ea3/run.stdout 2> /home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/video-topic-cleanup-fe666ea3/run.stderr || {
  f=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/video-topic-cleanup-fe666ea3/run.stderr
  if grep -q 'VIDEO_CLEANUP_' "$f";then exit 71;fi
  if grep -q 'ENOENT' "$f";then exit 72;fi
  if grep -q 'EACCES' "$f";then exit 73;fi
  if grep -q 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND' "$f";then exit 74;fi
  if grep -q 'getaddrinfo\|ECONN' "$f";then exit 75;fi
  if grep -q 'Cannot find module' "$f";then exit 76;fi
  if grep -q 'network\|mount\|volume' "$f";then exit 77;fi
  if grep -q 'Telegram API request failed' "$f";then exit 78;fi
  if grep -q 'TypeError\|ReferenceError' "$f";then exit 79;fi
  exit 80
}
echo VIDEO_DUPLICATE_CLEANUP_TELEGRAM_ACK_PASS
